descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-02 Patient List Capture · S24 Photo OCR is wired to Vertex Gemini and the prompt is passed unchanged

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T3 Photo and census scanning runs on Google Gemini Flash via Vertex AI. (TFA-94425 AC 1)
  • T4 The prototype's photo-reading instruction text is ported word for word. Only the request format changes, to fit Gemini's API. (TFA-94425 AC 2; TFA-94425 AC 3; TFA-94425 AC 4)

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given Provider configuration (api project, no network)

When Read the default vision provider/model, route a photo, and build the Vertex request

Then Default vision provider is vertex with a Gemini Flash model. A photo goes to the configured vision model with the prompt text unchanged. The request is the native Vertex shape (prompt part + inline image, minimal thinking, high media resolution, temperature 0)

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright assertions in api/providers.spec.ts. These check defaults only. S19 records which model was requested; the model that answered is not logged for vision. Temperature 0 vs the prototype's 0.2 is Q12

Where it ran: local lane A (existing Playwright tests); test method API · API (Convex functions); lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S24 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-02.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane A.

Test method: API · API (Convex functions) (API (Tim's providers spec, no network)); secondary: CONFIG · Config check — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local (spec) + CONFIG on dev; Source: matrix (lane A).

UAT item: TC-02 Patient List Capture · Section: A1 · Home Screen & Dashboard · Scenario: TC-02/S24

Photo OCR is wired to Vertex Gemini and the prompt is passed unchanged

Tickets: TFA-94425 Implement Vision/photo path (ready for qa)

Result: passed in matrix/TC-02.results.json (lane A: the existing Playwright specs below, run on the local stack; agent-matrix.sh).

Existing specs:

  • api/providers.spec.ts [api] — defaults photo OCR to Google Vertex Gemini — expected
  • api/providers.spec.ts [api] — builds the native Vertex photo OCR request with literal-reading controls — expected
  • api/providers.spec.ts [api] — routes photos using the explicit vision provider and model — expected

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A (Tim's Playwright specs): the e2e setup makes fresh accounts and seeds with an admin key, which dev does not have.. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
